ios.desc:
Pindigo is the premier social high score tracker for pinball players!

FEATURES:
• Easily keep track of your personal high scores wherever you are
• Add photo evidence to prove your score is legit
• Tag your scores with the locations and events where they were achieved
• Add personal notes to each score
• Find and follow your friends to see their scores and activity
• Like and comment on score posts
• Share your scores to Facebook, Twitter, and more
• Get notifications when friends interact with your score posts
• Check the machine/location/event leaderboards to see how you stack up
• Quick machine links to PinTips.net, PinballVideos.com, and others
• ..and MORE!

quotes.text:
Project: For over a year, I have been developing and maintaining a score-tracking social network for pinball players. We recently broke 1k users who have posted over 20k scores. I'm currently in the process of refactoring the entire codebase and updating/testing dependencies. Once the mobile app is polished I intend on making a web version as well. As a newer developer (~3 years), the scope of this app and the size of the target community are the perfect challenge for me. I've learned about deployments, image uploads, CDN, DBA, and community engagement.

Problem: I'm really struggling with deep-linking. I want to make sure that links open in the app if the app is available and fallback on opening on the site. Sharing to social media is also giving me a headache, but that's due to my stack.

I rewrote my social, score-tracking app for Pinball in react-native. Previously it was in Angularjs (ionic/cordova). Has ~6k registered users, ~300 daily active users, and earns ~$200 a month on Patreon.
